limits: Species are representative local vegetation, not an individual botanical survey.
Fixed spatial near/far classes from v09 retained. Dynamic distance LOD switching not implemented.
GLB is a neutral interchange source; no KN5 export, CSP tree registration or in-game performance test yet.
UV bark and alpha foliage textures are supplied; the final game shader mapping remains required.
method: Every existing planting transform retained. Minor twig cylinders removed, source trunk and principal bough coordinates retained. Near-route broadleaf trees use individual UV leaf cards at two-thirds of the original blade positions. Distant trees, pine sprays and shrubs use native-rendered clump cards in three-dimensional arrangements. No whole-tree billboard.
